senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be thin, shrunk, hard,] to be old.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48:18">Gen. R. s. 48</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 18:13">Gen. XVIII, 13</cite>) <he>ואני זָקַנְתִּי מלעשות וכ׳</he> am I (the Lord) too old to do wonders?
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 100b:5">Snh. 100ᵇ</cite> <he>הִזְקִינָה שמא וכ׳</he> when she arrives at old age, he is afraid lest &c.
<cite ref="Eruvin 56a:3">Erub. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>מַזְקִינִים בחצי וכ׳</he> they age in the middle of their days (prematurely).
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:6">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>כל זמן שמַזְקִינִין</he> the older they grow; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48:18">Gen. R. s. 48</cite> <he>אתם … ומזקינים חביריכם</he> you consider each himself young, and each his partner old (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 82">Yalk. ib. 82</cite> <he>ומז׳ אדניכם</he> and believe your Lord too old [to do wonders]); v. supra.

senses.gloss: to become old, weak, frail. Y. Ber. IX, end 14ᶜ (ref. to prov. XXIII, 22) אם נִזְדַּקְּנָה אומתך וכ׳ if thy nation is decaying (in faith), stand up and fence her in (prevent her being trodden upon); Yalk. Prov. 960.—2) (cmp. דקדק) to be maturely considered, be clear (beyond doubt);

units: Tosef. Snh. VII, 7 (the presiding judge declares) (נִיזְקַן) נִזְקַן הדין ed. Zuck. (Var. נזדקן, נזדקק); discussed in Snh. 42ᵃ מאי נזד׳ הדין what does nizdakken mean? Does it mean קש דינא the case is hard (difficult, so as to demand a reconsideration)?… It means חכם דינא the case is clear; Y. Snh. V, end, 23ᵃ
